request_fields.note: Changes the website and the consent page call not in this version, sent as a field on a live-proven route. Refused on every tenant and every lane, before approval, with no override (dispatch/admission.py check_evidence_holds). A rule applies to a request on its method and path template whose query, body, or URL query sends the field: 'true' when it is set to anything Canvas does not read as false, 'present' when it is sent at all, 'contains' when its value holds the given word. Publishing a New Quiz through its assignment or module item is refused after a read of the target (dispatch/executor.py _refuse_new_quiz_publish). When one of these is live-proven, lift its rule and the website line together.

learner_data.note: Operations touching learner PII. They are admitted only on a lane with a projection point and the encrypted learner vault (the Chromium lane with the optional 'cryptography' package), where every receipt is de-identified before the agent or the journal sees it; everywhere else they are refused (LearnerDataGated). users/self is the educator's own profile and is not learner data. Substrings were extended in the wave-3 hardening to cover every learner-bearing path the lane-8 gap scan found (students, search_users, recent_students, bulk_user_tags, gradeable_students, moderated_students, provisional_grades, custom_gradebook_columns, rubric_assessments, peer_reviews, bulk_user_progress, outcome_results, anonymous submissions, collaborations, conferences, audits, what-if grades, test-student reads, content-share users, submission summaries).
learner_data.url_segments_note: Structural rule: a URL path segment (placeholders such as {id} ignored) equal to an entry in url_segments, or ending with an entry in url_segment_suffixes, names a resource whose response carries people: user objects, student ids, or per-student data. It catches endpoints no substring anticipated (potential_collaborators, activity_stream, effective_due_dates, assignment overrides, date_details override lists, page revisions). url_substrings stay as a second net. Course content (pages, quizzes, assignments, modules) is deliberately not matched: projecting it would rewrite names inside content an educator may save back.

never_dispatch.note: These operations are never dispatchable through the installed product, for any caller, even with educator approval. They are the standing exclusions (proof directive 2026-09-20) and the catalog's excluded set: announcements, messages to people, support tickets, and operations that affect more than one course. canvas_create_external_feed_courses is here because an announcement external feed posts every item of the feed as an announcement.
never_dispatch.write_url_substrings_note: These URL patterns refuse changes only: any request that is not a GET or HEAD, and every request of an operation that is not a read. Changing CSP settings affects account security (C-93 is also named in tool_names); reading a course's CSP settings changes nothing, and C-94 is a live-proven read.

request_flags.is_announcement: posts an announcement and notifies every student in the course; Morrow for Muse never posts announcements, even when asked
request_flags.notify_of_update: sends every student in the course a notice about the change; Morrow for Muse never sends messages to people, even when asked
request_flags.as_user_id: makes Canvas act as another person (masquerading); Morrow for Muse never acts as anyone other than you, even when asked

never_dispatch.request_flags_note: A request whose query, body, or URL query sets one of these keys to anything Canvas does not read as false is refused on every route and every lane, before approval, with no override. The catalog's excluded set names the announcement variants of discussion create; the flag rule covers every route that accepts it, the topic update included. notify_of_update rides on assignment, page, and classic quiz create and edit; as_user_id (masquerading) rides on any route, a read included. The consent page lists all three under what Morrow will not do in this version, even if you ask.
